title: Deleting a term writes a row and its earlier rows stay
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Choose a name that no term has for the new term, term A.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type the name of term A in Name.
  3. Type 14 in the Days box.
  4. Click "Create Credit Term".
  5. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  6. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  7. Click the red "Delete Credit Term" button.
  8. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  9. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The field shows the name as typed.

Step 3:

  • The blue information line shows below the options.

Step 4:

  • The toast "term A created" shows.

Step 5:

  • The menu opens.

Step 6:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 7:

  • The toast "term A deleted" shows.

Step 8:

  • The menu opens.

Step 9:

  • The newest row reads "Credit term deleted" / "term A: 14 days after the invoice date", and the earlier "Credit term created" row for term A is still there below it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)
